<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/rest/report/conversations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns conversation-level records whose **update** time falls inside the given date
range.

To fetch the individual messages of these conversations, pass their UUIDs to **Get
chats data**.
